name: Pharmacy Summer Scholars
what_you_do: A one-week day program. Tour hospital pharmacies. Practice making medicines. Learn about pharmacy jobs and meet pharmacy students. Lunch is given.
who_can_apply: Students in grades 9 to 12 who are interested in pharmacy. About 30 are selected. No GPA rule listed.
pay_detail: $50. Fee waivers can be requested when accepted.
duration: 1 week, 9:30 am to 3:30 pm (2026: July 20 to 24). Not residential.
deadline_text: No deadline listed. The page said applications were open and accepted students hear back by early March. 2027 dates not posted.
how_to_apply: Register through the link on the VCU School of Pharmacy summer programs page. Questions: pharmacy@vcu.edu.
notes: Students are responsible for their own housing and transportation. The page is for 2026, so confirm the 2027 dates.
